title: badata
text: Data package: BA (Bundesagentur für Arbeit) regional job market statistics district (Kreis) occupational group (KldB 2010). Pure data package, exported functions (NAMESPACE lists roxygen boilerplate) — everything happens data-raw/*.R ships data/*.rda.

what: Where the raw data comes from
title: badata
text: open download. delivery paid, bespoke “Sonderauswertung” BA-Statistik-Service-West (statistik-service-west@arbeitsagentur.de), tied specific order number (e.g. 317-408036) referenced delivered filenames email subject line. Requesting update means emailing address, referencing previous order number replicate Kreis × KldB-2010 × year breakdown, finding public portal download. Two BA products per delivery: - *_ALO_OST_B_* / *-ALO-OST-B-* → unemployed (Arbeitslose) + jobs (Arbeitsstellen) → feeds unemployed_total, unemployed_foreigners, jobs - *_SvB_GeB* / *-SvB-GeB-* → employees subject social insurance (SvB) + marginally employed (GeB) → feeds employees_by_workplace (AO/Arbeitsort), employees_by_residence (WO/Wohnort) Source .xlsx files gitignored (data-raw/*.xlsx) never committed — parsed .rda output .

what: Standing gotcha: BA changes the export format between deliveries without notice
title: badata
text: trap (2026-07-30 update, order 334605 → 408036). Rerunning existing data-raw/*.R scripts unmodified new BA delivery produced silently wrong data three different ways, error. BA’s export format stable contract across delivery cycles. trusting rerun new files, diff raw header structure (row offsets, exact label text, sheet count/names) current scripts assume — assume “BA product name” means “layout.” Concretely hit round: - Row offset shift. unemployed/jobs file’s header block moved exactly one row deliveries (extra line inserted somewhere preamble). Silent check exact skip=/row content — error, just wrong columns read headers. - Abbreviated → full label text. "Sv-pflichtig Beschäftigte" → "Sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschäftigte", "Tätigkeit nach KldB 2010" → "Ausgeübte Tätigkeit nach KldB 2010". case_when(x == "old label", ...) match silently falls TRUE ~ x instead erroring, corrupts data quietly rather crashing. - Header cells used blank now contain literal filler text. new employees file writes literal word "darunter" every foreigners/women sub-column instead leaving blank, broke fill()-based label propagation collided employment types’ foreigners/women columns identical names. new unemployed/jobs file opposite: “total” sub-column’s header blank old file wrote "Insgesamt" literally, x == "Insgesamt" stopped matching group dropped instead set "total". - File bundling changed. Employees data moved one file two sheets (workplace/residence) two separate files, one sheet . Standing instruction. new BA files land data-raw/, re-running anything: readxl::excel_sheets() file, dump raw header rows (col_names = FALSE, skip) relevant sheet, diff current script’s assumed skip=/label strings. Treat every case_when/exact-string match parsing code thing can silently break, just row offsets.

what: Known pre-existing data quirks (not bugs, don’t “fix” without a deliberate decision)
title: badata
text: occupational_group_codes / region_codes won’t perfectly 1:1 match every BA product’s occupational_group/region values — categories catch-alls numeric KldB code (e.g. "ohne Angabe zum Zielberuf"). 0.2.0 get code = NA real name preserved (left_join() code/occupational_group works via NA-matching), rather code accidentally duplicating name column. Historical years get retroactively restated current administrative boundaries whenever BA/BKG changes Kreis boundaries (“Gebietsstand” convention). region code’s historical value can change package versions error — e.g. Hanau split Main-Kinzig-Kreis Kreisfreie Stadt (06415) 0.2.0 delivery, retroactively applied back 2016. BA right thing (comparable boundaries across years), defect, mean 06435’s 2016 value differs badata 0.1.x 0.2.0. Check NEWS.md assuming rerun reproduce old values exactly. BA’s disclaimer (“Datenrevisionen können zu Abweichungen … führen”) means small fraction (seen: ~0.3-1.5%) overlapping-year values legitimately differ release release. Don’t chase 100% reproduction old values correctness bar; anti-join keys (naive full outer join value columns) separate “row genuinely absent” “value merely changed.”

title: badata
text: shapefile ships package (’s Kreis-code tabular data ). map, join region_codes$code (table’s region/occupational_group column) BKG’s official VG250 Kreis boundaries (daten.gdz.bkg.bund.de/produkte/vg/vg250_ebenen_0101/aktuell/..., VG250_KRS layer, join key AGS) — AGS/Kreis-code system BA uses, joins cleanly without name-matching. GADM’s German boundaries (used elsewhere workspace, e.g. RegioPress/data/geo/gadm/) use NAME_2, AGS codes, guaranteed current recent Kreis boundary changes (Hanau) — prefer VG250 package specifically.

what: CI: “Update CITATION.cff” workflow is broken (org policy, not the workflow itself)
title: badata
text: .github/workflows/update-citation-cff.yaml runs cff_write() correctly git push step fails 403 (Permission ... denied github-actions[bot]), silently swallowed workflow’s git push || echo "changes commit", job still reports success. Root cause: RegioHub org-level Actions policy “Workflow permissions” set read-, overriding repo-level setting. Fixing needs org owner change github.com/organizations/RegioHub/settings/actions (via gh api -X PUT orgs/RegioHub/actions/permissions/workflow, needs admin:org OAuth scope — gh auth refresh -h github.com -s admin:org complete device-code browser flow). ’s fixed, regenerate CITATION.cff manually DESCRIPTION/inst/CITATION change: conda run -n rstats Rscript -e 'library(cffr); cff_write(keys = list())', commit normal commit (push works fine, ’s bot’s default token ’s restricted).

title: badata 0.2.0
text: New data delivery BA (Auftragsnummer 408036) extends coverage: employees_by_workplace/employees_by_residence now span 2013-2025 (previously 2016-2021), jobs/unemployed_total/ unemployed_foreigners now span 2012-2025 (previously 2012-2021). Fixed two parsing bugs surfaced change BA’s export format: “darunter” (foreigners/women) sub-columns colliding identical names across two employee types, silently dropping foreigners/women breakdown one un-labeled “total” sub-column dropped entirely instead set "total" group column employees_by_workplace/employees_by_residence Fixed pre-existing bug, present since original release, region_occupation_codes.R picked source sheet’s trailing metadata line (“Erstellungsdatum: …”) bogus entry region_codes. Fixed occupational_group_codes’s “ohne Angabe zum Zielberuf” catch-category, previously string duplicated code name. now code = NA correct name, left_join() NA occupational_group values main tables now attaches label correctly. Hanau split Main-Kinzig-Kreis independent city (region code 06415), retroactively restated across historical years per BA’s “Gebietsstand Juli 2026” convention. Anyone comparing region 06435 figures pre-0.2.0 data see level shift, since now excludes Hanau’s share. 4 military occupational codes (011-014, e.g. “Offiziere”) longer reported employees export absent employees_by_workplace/employees_by_residence release . Remaining differences overlapping years (roughly 0.3-1.5% matched cells) reflect BA’s disclosed data-revision policy, parsing issue. Konstantin Wandel joins package author.
